intro: The Windsor sofa bed is a master of transformation. With a queen-size pull-out bed, adjustable armrests, and hidden storage, it turns small spaces into a cosy, multi-functional retreat.

features.title: A sofa bed that’s perfect for everyone
features.text: The Windsor sofa bed transforms effortlessly from a two-seater sofa into a queen-size bed, making it simple and safe to use for all ages.

features.title: Extra storage to keep essentials organised
features.text: Features a pull-out storage compartment under the bed, perfect for storing bedding, seasonal clothes, or anything you want to keep out of sight.

features.title: Cushions built for relaxing and sleeping
features.text: Equipped with soft foam cushions, this sofa bed offers the right balance of support and comfort for both sitting and sleeping.

features.title: Designed to last with a strong metal frame
features.text: The tubular metal frame provides long-lasting durability, ensuring the sofa bed stays reliable for years.

features.title: Adjustable armrests for flexible seating
features.text: Armrests can be adjusted easily for casual lounging or formal seating, adding versatility to this space-saving piece.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
